prompts.walk_draft: Production game animation sprite sheet: repair a walking cycle for the EXACT girl in image1 (identity master) and image2 (current neutral sprite/style). SAME identity, head size, clothing details in EVERY frame. Draw 8 consecutive poses for ONE FULL walking cycle toward viewer LEFT in the same near-front three-quarter camera. Each foot stays attached to its correct colored-patch leg.
